ArchiveRfcRequestV1.rule: The client never sends branch member revisions or an authoritative member list. The writer recomputes the complete current scope, revisions and archive states under the UnitOfWork and exact-compares reviewed_scope_fingerprint.

RestoreRfcArchiveOperationRequestV1.rule: The command response uses RfcArchiveOperationV1 with at most 32 members in its first page; continuation uses the ordinary GetRfcArchiveOperation cursor contract. This bound is transport/replay representation only and never limits how many operation members are restored.

PendingRfcTerminalCascadeQueryV1.rule: cursor semantic body is pinned by queries/rfc-lifecycle.json GetPendingRfcTerminalCascade and binds resolved pending proposal identity/revision/scope fingerprint

RfcTerminalCascadePreviewQueryV1.rule: cursor is bound to exact proposal revision plus preview_fingerprint; changed scope or cross-domain impact authority invalidates continuation

body_fields.execution_review: RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionReviewV1 emitted by a READY PreviewRfcTerminalCascade
body_fields.deliberate_action_proof: LLD12 deliberate-action proof bound to proposal target, proposal_revision and execution_review.preview_fingerprint

ExecuteRfcTerminalCascadeRequestV1.rule: scope_fingerprint alone is not execution authority; writer recomputes current scope/provider summaries and requires exact reviewed preview fingerprint before proof consumption

body_fields.uow: existing LLD-01 UnitOfWork owned by LLD-04 AcceptReconciliationProposal
body_fields.proposal: accepted LLD-04 RFC reconciliation proposal carrying exact proposal/revision/fingerprint/base-token bindings and accepted source-evidence delta
body_fields.command_context: in-process LLD-04 parent command context carrying outer command_id/hash and already-inserted parent command_receipt reference

fields.scope_fingerprint: SOMA_RFC_ARCHIVE_SCOPE_V1 lowercase sha256 hex over complete current scope

rules: scope_fingerprint binds complete member identity/revision/archive_state authority even though items are paged
reviewed_branch requested RFC is parentless and ordered first; direct children follow by rfc_id UTF-8 ascending
outcome=archived iff changed_rfc_count>0 and rfc_archive_operation_id is non-null
outcome=no_change iff changed_rfc_count=0 and rfc_archive_operation_id is null
fixed-size result never embeds archive members; material clients read operation members through GetRfcArchiveOperation
exact committed result is replayed without later state reconstruction

fields.restore_eligible: bool derived true iff current_archive_state=archived and latest_event_type=archived and latest_event_origin_archive_operation_id equals the queried operation id

rules: latest event is selected by greatest resulting_rfc_revision for that RFC; timestamp is never ordering authority
pre_archive_revision, archived_revision and ordinal are immutable operation-membership evidence; current/latest fields are a read-time projection
member rows order by ordinal ASC then rfc_id ASC

fields.exact_member_count: int>=0 exact immutable operation membership count

rules: Operation identity/membership are immutable; restore eligibility derives from latest per-member archive events.

GetRfcArchiveOperation may use requested limit 1..500 default 100; RestoreRfcArchiveOperation command response uses at most 32 members in its first page so the exact replay snapshot remains within the Foundation response collection bound.
The command-response page bound never limits restore mutation cardinality; all eligible immutable operation members are processed before the bounded projection is built.
ArchiveRfc returns fixed-size ArchiveRfcResultV1 and clients use this read route for operation members.

RfcTerminalCascadeStateV1.rule: scope_fingerprint and terminal evidence are exact persisted proposal capture authority and never rebuilt from paged response members for replay/read

RfcTerminalCascadeDetailV1.rule: members are persisted immutable evidence ordered RFC before WFM then stored ordinal/member identity; continuation binds exact pending proposal

fields.blockers: bounded typed array from closed hard-delete guard registry

rules: RFC terminal-cascade preview response and cross-packet impact/execution-review types are owned by types/rfc-terminal-cascade-preview.json.
RFC archive scope fingerprint bytes are owned by algorithms/rfc-archive.json with golden vectors in algorithms/rfc-archive-scope-golden-vectors.json.
